limits: General shape-only one-field greedy reduction of summed per-card peak excess; stable ties and joint-halving plateau fallback. Conservative joint halving unchanged.
No change to memory envelope, per-device margin, input-dependent graph scheduler, logical capacities, dtype, loss normalization or update boundary. No numerical prepass.
Only consumer planning/recording changes; qualified resident/core/CANN bytes unchanged. Installed client freshly linked after source/header/options-verified object reuse.
CPU13 includes24 varied geometry comparisons and32 constrained cases across both policies. NPU17 includes16 executed CPU-reference comparisons plus one preallocation refusal.
